page.content:
France's 1998 final scorer and the 2006 red-card tragedy.

How Zinedine Zidane connects

  • Faction: France national team — Zidane headed France to the 1998 World Cup on home soil.
  • Event: 1998 FIFA World Cup — Zidane scored twice in the 1998 World Cup final.

What is Zinedine Zidane?

Zinedine Zidane headed two goals in the 1998 final against Brazil, then ended his career with a headbutt in the 2006 final — two World Cup images that still travel together.

Key threads lead to France national team and 1998 FIFA World Cup.
